response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_avg) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: Qualifying tracks have nonzero Milliseconds, so their bytes-per-millisecond ratios are defined.
